notes.description: The root note (Shadja). Always fixed; the foundation of all Indian classical music.
Komal Rishabh — the flattened second. Used in Raag Bhairav and Raag Todi.
Shuddha Rishabh — the natural second. Common in most raags.
Komal Gandhar — the flattened third. Used in Raag Kafi and Raag Asavari.
Shuddha Gandhar — the natural third. Used in Bilawal Thaat raags.
Shuddha Madhyam — the perfect fourth. Common in most raags.
Tivra Madhyam — the sharp/augmented fourth. Used in Raag Yaman (Kalyan Thaat).
Pancham — the perfect fifth. Almost always present; said to be 'achal' (immovable).
Komal Dhaivat — the flattened sixth. Used in Raag Bhairav and Bhairavi.
Shuddha Dhaivat — the natural sixth. Common in Kafi and Bilawal raags.
Komal Nishad — the flattened seventh. Used in Raag Kafi, Asavari, Bhairavi.
Shuddha Nishad — the natural seventh. Used in Bilawal and Kalyan Thaat raags.
